notes.title: The Second Chapter, Patch Notes AND Franchises
notes.notes:
There's a massive patch out for WIGWWAG, make sure to update for these explosive changes!

Patch Notes

Large Changes:

When the villain known as the Carver was speaking to Georgia in that alley there was a spelling error:
I am no feline Georgia! You are I are alike, me and you. You and me. We complete each other.
Changed ARE to AND.
This was the only grammatical mistake fixed because

Small Changes:

Added a link to the second chapter on the title screen.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2326460/The_Magical_Land_of_Canada/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42726885/55aaee3162d86aa3750c6ce669844c48a22f51b2.png

You can click on it and it will bring you to the Steam page BUT it has no accompanying clicky sound effect when clicked so this might be a shock to some.

Medium Changes:

What if George Washington was a Girl and The Magical Land of Canada are franchised

https://store.steampowered.com/search/?franchise=Alter%20Historia

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42726885/07679d3a62782dee16f0644e0491afe57c693dd9.png

That's all
